Messages.Author: blackday
Messages.Body:
I have two questions regarding Ilomba.
The first question. When stealing the ilomba, it is placed automatically on the stealing minion? He does not get the choice to place it on another minion right?
The second question. When Zhenga recruits an ally e.g. procurer and the meth has 3 Ilombas in his hand, can he burn 3 blood and place each Ilomba to a different minion? The meth only has to declare that he is recruiting the ally and does not have to announce the other retainer/allies he drops later, right?

Name: Ilomba
[EK:R]
Cardtype: Retainer
Animal with 1 life. Requires a Laibon.
Put Ilomba on any minion (this is a +1 stealth  action if that minion is controlled by another Methuselah). If Ilomba would burn a life (or would otherwise be burned), this minion burns a blood or life instead. If he or she cannot, he or she is burned. A minion may have only one Ilomba.
Artist: Ron Spencer

Name: Zhenga
[LoB:U]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Follower of Set
Group: 4
Capacity: 5
Discipline: obf pre SER
Laibon: When Zhenga announces a recruit action or employ action, she may burn X blood. If the action succeeds, she may recruit and employ up to X additional allies and retainers from your hand (pay cost as normal).
Artist: Jim Pavelec

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> blackday wrote:
> I have two questions regarding Ilomba.
> The first question. When stealing the ilomba, it is placed automatically on the stealing minion? He does not get the choice to place it on another minion right?
>
With which card?

> blackday wrote:
> The second question. When Zhenga recruits an ally e.g. procurer and the meth has 3 Ilombas in his hand, can he burn 3 blood and place each Ilomba to a different minion? The meth only has to declare that he is recruiting the ally and does not have to announce the other retainer/allies he drops later, right?
>
Zhenga can burn 3 blood to recruit 3 Ilombas. But retainers are put by default on the vampire that employs them, so you can't choose 3 targets to put the Ilombas on them.

stealing with maybe something like far mastery.

So the ability of the Ilomba that allows it to be put on another minion, can't be used by Zhenga when she uses her ability?

Messages.Author: GreyB
Messages.Body:
> ankha wrote:
> Zhenga can burn 3 blood to recruit 3 Ilombas. But retainers are put by default on the vampire that employs them, so you can't choose 3 targets to put the Ilombas on them.
>
The real question is; when does the "Put Ilomba on ..." apply?

1.) When employed (any means, not just action).
2.) When taken control of.
3.) On explicit employ ACTION

I don't think it's 2 or 3. Which would mean you can choose targets when you employ them using Zhenga's ability. And you cannot choose targets when stealing an Ilomba.

Interestingly, you would also avoid the whole D action clause using Zhenga's ability...

Sidenote: Charnas the Imp has the same issue, so kinda surprising there's no LSJ ruling on this.

**EDIT**
I am not saying this is the answer, fact is, I don't know and I don't think Ankha's answer can be claimed correct either yet. This is typically a VTES quirk that needs a ruling. I was unable to find one.

-1 Strength
